en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 448 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ibn Faddal and Ibn Abi Najran from Hammad bin Isa from Ibrahim bin Umar Yamani from Abu Basir from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said:
“The kingdom of these men will not disappear until they slaughter people in Kufa on Friday. It is as if I was looking at heads falling between the Gate of al-Feel and (the place of) the soap-sellers.
